process: Hydrogen blending into natural gas networks (Sect. 5.2 and 6.1-6.2)
value: Demonstrations at about 2% to 30% by volume in distribution networks; Hawaii Gas has run an average of about 12% (12-15%) hydrogen in its network since the 1970s, the longest-running US blend; projects commissioning now target up to 100%.
